title: Bitcoin self-custody solutions see record downloads amid ban
content: TL;DR: Amid escalating global banking concerns, a surge in downloads for Bitcoin self-custody solutions underscores a profound shift towards individual monetary sovereignty. This flight from centralized financial risk directly reinforces Bitcoin's foundational promise as the hardest money, secured by a formidable 948.56 EH/s hashrate and a robust difficulty of 146.47 T. For transactors, this moment demands immediate action: secure your keys, understand network dynamics, and embrace the unparalleled freedom Bitcoin offers.
author: Al Ingle
